anchors.note: A twelve-month paid trial of a low-cost training app that the prospect himself judged insufficient — he stayed 'off and on' with it and wants something 'a little bit more personal'. As stated it works for the offer: the cheap self-serve substitute is already disqualified in his own words, which is exactly the anchor that usually undercuts a $6,000 price. The rep never picked it up, so it was neither reinforced nor converted into value. It could still flip to undercutting if a price lands far above app pricing with this comparison left unaddressed.

unmet_demand.why_unmet: The programme supplies remote coaching, programming and video-review accountability, not an in-person or peer training partner. The rep did not respond to the statement at all, so whether the Skool community or coach check-ins would satisfy the underlying want was never tested.
